name: Publishable package identity excludes machine-local inputs

applicability.reason: Supported. C026 makes a publishable package declare a reverse-domain package_id and an api_major and puts both into named nominal Type identity; C029 makes a same-major hot upgrade explicit and transactional while PRESERVING compatible stable identities. Both are observable: the fixture reports identity (org.iris.v913, 1), the declared Class reports the same package, and an explicit upgrade to 1.0.1 moves the VERSION while leaving the package identity and the Class's package identity unchanged, which is exactly the preservation C029 requires. C028's one-active-revision rule and C030's runtime-local manifestless identity are observed by their own rows, META-V352 and the manifestless identity probe, rather than restated here.
